paul (Customer): Hey team — after a bulk SCIM invite from our Okta connector last night, ~40% of invited users show in the org but get 403 when opening projects. SCIM claims show role attrs but console says 'No access'. Anyone seen this?

nina: Hi Paul :wave: can you share an example affected user and whether the SCIM payload shows group->role mapping?

paul (Customer): Sure — paul.jenkins@acme.com. In SCIM we see membership in 'acme-devs' and a roles attr that should be "project:dev=writer" but in some audit entries it looks like "project:dev=wr" (truncated).

alan: That rings alarm bells — if the role string is truncated the RBAC parser may ignore it and create a membership without a project role, which explains 403. Do you have the raw SCIM batch payload or connector logs?

paul (Customer): Snippet from our SCIM push log: ```PUT /scim/v2/Users/12345
payload: { "userName": "paul.jenkins@acme.com", "roles": ["project:dev=wr"] }``` Okta returned a partial error: "batch item failed: attribute_length_exceeded" for some entries but still marked success for the job.

okta-bot: Automated notice: Okta SCIM connector reported attribute_length_exceeded for attribute 'roles' in batch 0x7f4 at 2024-03-05T02:14:23Z.

nina: Thanks — that matches the hypothesis. Truncated role strings will not match our project role pattern (we expect `project:<name>=<role>`), so they get ignored during role assignment. Quick test: can you remove and re-add one affected user in the console UI to force role recompute and confirm access?

paul (Customer): I tried re-invite for paul.jenkins — access was restored immediately. But we have hundreds affected, so manual fixes aren't practical.

sre-oncall: We'll need an automated repair. Alan, can infra run a reprocess job to rehydrate roles from raw SCIM audit logs and validate role attr lengths, mapping truncated strings where safe? Mark escalation if data loss risk is high.

alan: I'll open INF-7621 and schedule a low-risk reprocess. Need: raw SCIM batch files for 2024-03-05 02:00-03:30 UTC, a sample list of affected users (CSV), and any Okta connector logs. Plan: 1) validate role patterns, 2) re-run assignment logic for affected users, 3) emit audit events for changes.

paul (Customer): I'll send the CSV and grant nina-support@acme.com temporary org-admin so you can validate. Also can you add a pre-check to the SCIM ingestion to reject jobs with truncated role attrs instead of silently accepting?

nina: Good suggestion — I'll file a product/infra request to add explicit validation and a clearer error to the UI and the Okta connector docs. For now, please DM the CSV and the batch IDs. We'll update this thread with INF-7621 progress.

sre-oncall: Escalation noted, assigning to eng-infra. Will post job start/completion here. For visibility: workaround = re-add user (forces recompute); long-term = reprocess + validation.

paul (Customer): Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage.

nina: Thanks Paul, keeping this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
